items.title: 3 Beaten-Down Dividend Stocks Wall Street Abandoned That Still Pay You 7%
items.summary: Wall Street has soured on UPS, General Mills, and Best Buy for very different reasons, but all three still send out checks that yield as much as 7%. Whether that income is a trap or a rare opportunity depends on what the market is actually pricing in.

items.title: Is Best Buy (BBY) A Bargain On Its Debt Filing And New Partnerships?
items.summary: Best Buy (BBY) has just filed a shelf registration for debt securities, giving the retailer a flexible way to tap credit markets when it chooses to raise capital. Best Buy’s share price has eased in the past week, with a 7 day share price return of down 2.5% and a 1 day move slightly lower. However, the 30 day and 90 day share price returns of 9.8% and 16.6% suggest momentum has been building through late 2026. items.title: What Does Best Buy (BBY) Fire TV Deal Mean For Its Ad Business?
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) and Amazon announced an expanded multiyear Fire TV partnership focused on connected TV advertising and media tools. The agreement keeps Fire TV as the exclusive operating system on all Insignia branded televisions sold through Best Buy. Brands using Best Buy Ads and Amazon Ads gain access to new programmatic and AI powered tools to plan and optimize Fire TV campaigns. items.title: Best Buy’s 4.2% Yield Looks Attractive. Can the Dividend Survive a Bad Year?
items.summary: Best Buy has raised its dividend every year since 2015 and currently yields 4.2%, but a soft consumer year once pushed coverage to the razor's edge. Here is what the cash flow record reveals about whether that quarterly check holds up when the holiday season disappoints.

items.title: Best Buy Is Turning Amazon Fire TV Into a New Advertising Opportunity
items.summary: Best Buy is expanding its Fire TV ad partnership with Amazon, growing its high-margin media network toward $1 billion in revenue as a new CEO takes over amid hardware cost pressures.

items.title: 5 Broker-Liked Stocks to Watch Amid Fed's First Rate Hike in 3 Years
items.summary: Fed rate hike and persistent inflation put broker-favored Beazer Homes, Best Buy, Alaska Air, RXO and AMN Healthcare stocks in focus.

items.title: Meta's new AI device changes everything
items.summary: Everyone's talking about the meteoric rise of Meta's Muse, but Zuck's real power move dropped a day later: a secretive, keychain-sized AI device with a camera and mic, shipped months ahead of OpenAI's rumored rival. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the Muse Charm news from Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii, and unpacks the biggest stories of the week from Meta Connect and beyond.

items.summary: Meta’s new AI agent Muse will soon make the company money from transactions made through the platform.
